DC V4, subclustering and ADT

V4 (original V4.1)

Realized CellCycleScoreing and related statistics are calculated with one human only gene name “Hn1”, which should be “Jpt1”. Should only affect cellcyclescoring, counts, and plots. Should not affect clustering and DEGs.

Then realized another 2 outdated genes: Fam64a -> Pimreg; Mlf1ip-> Cenpu https://github.com/liuyigh/tinyatlas/blob/master/cell_cycle/Mus_musculus.csv

Confirmed with python sets that three genes are different. Hence redo cell cycle.

See Enrichr Analysis of 56 genes

```r

library(gridExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggheatmap)
plots <- list() 
for (i in seq(4)) {
  plots[[i]] <- ggheatmap(as.data.frame.matrix(round(prop.table(ccCountHashSubReg[,,i], 2)*100, 1)), orderCol = F, colorPalette = \PuRd\)
}

ggplot(SRclu1Mkr, aes(x=avg_logFC, y=-log10(p_val_adj), label=row.names(SRclu1Mkr))) + geom_point(size = 1) +
      geom_label_repel(data=  SRclu1Mkr[log10(SRclu1Mkr$p_val_adj) < -30,], aes(label = row.names(SRclu1Mkr[log10(SRclu1Mkr$p_val_adj) < -30,])),
                      box.padding = unit(0.5, 'lines'),
                  segment.color = 'deepskyblue'
                  )

# plot cluster 1 DEG, pct expression fold change (ifelse ave_logFC for direction of change) vs p value adjusted 

<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin eyJkYXRhIjoiYGBgclxuYGBgclxuZ2dwbG90KFNSY2x1MU1rciwgYWVzKHg9cGN0Rm9sZCppZmVsc2UoYXZnX2xvZ0ZDID4wLCAxLCAtMSksIHk9LWxvZzEwKHBfdmFsX2FkaiksIGxhYmVsPXJvdy5uYW1lcyhTUmNsdTFNa3IpKSkgKyBnZW9tX3BvaW50KHNpemUgPSAxKSArXG4gICAgICBnZW9tX2xhYmVsX3JlcGVsKGRhdGE9ICBTUmNsdTFNa3JbbG9nMTAoU1JjbHUxTWtyJHBfdmFsX2FkaikgPCAtMzAsXSwgYWVzKGxhYmVsID0gcm93Lm5hbWVzKFNSY2x1MU1rcltsb2cxMChTUmNsdTFNa3IkcF92YWxfYWRqKSA8IC0zMCxdKSksXG4gICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgYm94LnBhZGRpbmcgPSB1bml0KDAuNSwgJ2xpbmVzJyksXG4gICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICBzZWdtZW50LmNvbG9yID0gJ2RlZXBza3libHVlJ1xuICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgKVxuYGBgXG5gYGAifQ== -->

```r
```r
ggplot(SRclu1Mkr, aes(x=pctFold*ifelse(avg_logFC >0, 1, -1), y=-log10(p_val_adj), label=row.names(SRclu1Mkr))) + geom_point(size = 1) +
      geom_label_repel(data=  SRclu1Mkr[log10(SRclu1Mkr$p_val_adj) < -30,], aes(label = row.names(SRclu1Mkr[log10(SRclu1Mkr$p_val_adj) < -30,])),
                      box.padding = unit(0.5, 'lines'),
                  segment.color = 'deepskyblue'
                  )

```r
```r
Idents(dcSubReg) <- \seurat_clusters\
Clu12Mkr <- FindMarkers(dcSubReg, ident.1 = 1, ident.2 = 2, min.pct = 0.10, logfc.threshold = 0.10)
Clu12Mkr$pctDiff <- abs(Clu12Mkr$pct.1 - Clu12Mkr$pct.2)
Clu12Mkr$pctFold1 <- Clu12Mkr$pct.1 / Clu12Mkr$pct.2
Clu12Mkr$pctFold2 <- Clu12Mkr$pct.2 / Clu12Mkr$pct.1
Clu12Mkr$pctFold <- apply(Clu12Mkr[c(7,8)], 1, max)
write.csv(Clu12Mkr, \~/scRNAseq/analysis/DEGs/DEG-CCRegSub/DEG-Clu1v2-CCSubReg-20191118.csv\)
